steps.domain_action: Select an even integer n greater than 2
Fix n as the invariant target of the operation
Bifurcate n into the space of all possible additive pairs
Hold the set of all pairs (a, b) where a + b = n in superposition
Iterate through the first element a of each pair
Apply the primality sieve to the first element a
Branch the logic based on the primality of a
a is composite, discard the pair
Return to the next candidate in the iteration
a is prime, designate as p
Rejoin the logic to evaluate the complement b
Calculate the complement q by subtracting p from n
Apply the primality sieve to the complement q
Branch the logic based on the primality of q
q is composite, discard the pair
Return to the next candidate in the iteration
q is prime, designate as a valid partition
Rejoin p and q into a confirmed pair
Sum p and q to reconstitute the original integer n
Record the pair (p, q) in the permanent partition log for n
Close the set of all prime pairs for the given n
